Default exit multiple to the entry multiple, fix example deal returns

A hardcoded 4x exit multiple against an 8.7x entry can only destroy
value: the Example tab was demoing 0.80x MOIC / -5.3% IRR, and any
live deal missing an exit assumption would have shown the same fake
catastrophe.

rather than an unrelated constant; the constant remains only as a
last resort when the entry multiple is underivable. The example deal
model is set to a consistent 9x. Example now shows 1.36x / 7.1%.

The repo's typecheck was red (4 errors); Vite/esbuild built anyway so
they shipped silently. Two were real functional bugs:

- DealTimelineCard read synthesis.synthesizedAt, a field that does not

  always blank. Now uses projectProcessedAt.
- The page passed onRunSynthesis/runningSynthesis to ProjectPortfolioCard,

  the card. Added the props and a Run synthesis button on the active
  project.

Plus two safety/type fixes:
- ReturnsDecisionSummary used a possibly-null equity in the debt
  calculation (crash risk); now guarded.
- DealCharts label formatter typed its param as number when recharts
  passes RenderableText; coerce with Number().

oldMessage:
Fix deal-model fact hydration: read real financialFactsJson array shape

The quant layer showed 'inputs needed' on every live deal even though
the per-document analysis had extracted the facts. hydrateModelFacts-
FromDocuments assumed financialFactsJson was a field-keyed object with
.value/.status and explicitly skipped arrays — but n8n actually emits
an array of { metric, normalized_value, period, status, citation }, so
the bridge silently no-oped on all real data.

New utils/documentedFacts.ts parses the real array shape, picks the
latest period per metric (preferring confirmed, then higher
confidence), and maps to the documented-facts object the quant cards
read. hydrateModelFactsFromDocuments now uses it. Verified live: a
freshly submitted healthy packet's revenue/EBITDA now populate the
Overview/Valuation/Returns cards instead of 'inputs needed'.
